formula_checks.name: hasWage
formula_checks.reviewer_why: Presence detector: a stored table is evidence of a wage record even when an explicit row is zero; this does not assert positive pay.
formula_checks.what_the_code_actually_does: The reviewer found it right; its five cases agree with the app.

formula_checks.name: earnerWages
formula_checks.reviewer_why: Honors the explicit who-earns selection and uses the spouse’s own wage record; no household sum is substituted into a person’s row.
formula_checks.what_the_code_actually_does: The reviewer found it right; its five cases agree with the app.

formula_checks.name: hasTwoEarners
formula_checks.reviewer_why: True exactly when the selected wage list has two records, rather than from marital status alone.
formula_checks.what_the_code_actually_does: The reviewer found it right; its five cases agree with the app.

formula_checks.name: sumOverEarners
formula_checks.reviewer_why: Adding known values is correct, but a missing figure becomes 0 without completeness metadata.
formula_checks.reviewer_should_be: Return the known subtotal with missing-item metadata, or refuse the complete total.
formula_checks.what_the_code_actually_does: Adds what each earner's figure returns; both callers return $0 for a blank, never a missing figure, and a blank 401(k) means "none" on the screen. Records fix: the card should say a blank figure is $0 by its callers' design.

formula_checks.name: sumMonthsOverEarners
formula_checks.reviewer_why: Adds the same calendar slots across the earners; an explicit zero month remains zero.
formula_checks.what_the_code_actually_does: The reviewer found it right; its five cases agree with the app.

formula_checks.name: householdPreTaxContributionsAnnual
formula_checks.reviewer_why: Multiplies every monthly contribution by 12 although householdK401ByMonth counts contributions only in paid months.
formula_checks.reviewer_should_be: Add the twelve values of householdK401ByMonth.
formula_checks.what_the_code_actually_does: Each earner's monthly 401(k) × 12, against MK-CF-F-206 which counts paid months only; the Tax organizer's 401(k) step reads it while the tax is worked on the paid months.
formula_checks.plain_example: One earner from July ($713.27) and one all year ($398.43): $13,340.40; right $9,060.78.
formula_checks.fixed_2026_10_25: FIXED 2026-10-25 (FIX-INCOME-A, landed 2026-10-26): Σ householdK401ByMonth — the count the tax is worked on; the Tax organizer's 401(k) step reads it.

formula_checks.name: monthKey
formula_checks.reviewer_why: Uses the person’s local calendar month; UTC date conversion must not change it. Cases include offset crossings.
formula_checks.what_the_code_actually_does: The reviewer found it right; its five cases agree with the app.

formula_checks.name: monthWindow
formula_checks.reviewer_why: Calendar arithmetic across year boundaries; count is a nonnegative integer and back is an integer.
formula_checks.what_the_code_actually_does: The reviewer found it right; its five cases agree with the app.

formula_checks.name: salaryMonths
formula_checks.reviewer_why: Preserves year-month keys and explicit zero; legacy twelve-cell arrays have the explicitly documented current-year interpretation.
formula_checks.what_the_code_actually_does: The reviewer found it right; its five cases agree with the app.

formula_checks.name: hasMonthlySalaryTable
formula_checks.reviewer_why: Presence detector for the canonical month map, retaining a zero row.
formula_checks.what_the_code_actually_does: The reviewer found it right; its five cases agree with the app.

formula_checks.name: salaryCalendarYear
formula_checks.reviewer_why: Reads the requested dated slots, using the explicit fallback only for absent keys; zero is preserved.
formula_checks.what_the_code_actually_does: The reviewer found it right; its five cases agree with the app.

formula_checks.name: salaryWindow
formula_checks.reviewer_why: Reads the requested dated slots, using the explicit fallback only for absent keys; zero is preserved.
formula_checks.what_the_code_actually_does: The reviewer found it right; its five cases agree with the app.

formula_checks.name: withSalaryMonth
formula_checks.reviewer_why: Writing a known amount is correct, but blank becomes an explicit 0 and destroys the distinction between clearing a cell and entering zero.
formula_checks.reviewer_should_be: Preserve an empty/unentered cell separately, unless an approved editor contract explicitly makes blank a confirmed zero.
formula_checks.what_the_code_actually_does: Writes toNum(amount): a cleared cell becomes $0. No ruling says whether clearing means "not entered" or "$0".
